tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Vide assessment order dated 31-03-2025 the Assessing Officer- Income Tax had added under reported income of Rs. 67,40,097/- for the A.Y. 2023-24 and initiated penalty proceedings in respect thereof. An appeal was filed before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) on 31-03-2025 and was pending before him.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax, Central Circle-17, Delhi
tax_litigation.status: The Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) vide order dated 29-01-2026 has allowed the appeal by directing the Assessing Officer to delete the addition of Rs. 67,40,097/-. Further, certain discrepancies has been observed in the CIT(A) order for which rectification application u/s 154 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 has been filed which is currently pending adjudication before CIT(A).

operating_notes.text: FY26 net gain on fair value changes was ₹7.63 Cr against ₹73.67 Cr in FY25, and Q4FY26 alone was a ₹107.68 Cr loss.
Investments stood at ₹1,935.91 Cr against net worth of ₹2,113.31 Cr at 31 March 2026.
Buyback of 26,31,578 shares at ₹380 each used ₹100 Cr; post-buyback paid-up capital is ₹31.50 Cr across 3,13,78,663 shares.
VLS Asset Management Limited, struck off under Section 248, contributed nil turnover and nil net worth in the last financial year.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹-98.86 Cr, net loss ₹74.54 Cr (against a loss of ₹39.83 Cr a year earlier).
2026-10-19: Registrar of Companies, Delhi approved the Section 248 strike-off of subsidiary VLS Asset Management Limited, which ceased to be a subsidiary from that date.
